feature_contract.goal: Provide a readable native-resolution F11 settings shell and first-run modal with scalable TrueType fallback, consistent keyboard/gamepad/mouse font editing, persistent preferences after failed disk writes, and protected single-image external VR composition.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Native external Dear ImGui overlay font loading and first-run modal persistence only; preserve R30 external overlay semantics, existing full-shell responsive layout, game-owned HUD/GOAL, world/SkyGlow, desktop bindings and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Dear ImGui first-run Font Scale edit and standard settings share Overlay global font density/persistence state.
EndScene rebuilds a cached Windows TrueType font atlas and submits external-screen ImGui geometry through its separate D3D9 draw owner.
R30's scoped external overlay draw maps desktop backbuffer to both XR eyes; native eye extents and shell density preserve legibility, independent of game HUD.
subcomponents: Search bounded scalable Segoe UI/Tahoma/Arial font bytes once, tolerating missing/corrupt candidates and OOM without blindly upscaling the 13px default bitmap face.

Route first-run modal font edits through the regular F11 pending commit so atlas regeneration, INI retry on failure, keyboard/gamepad deactivation, close and controller focus share one coherent transaction.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: F11 native size remains set by XR eye density and user font scale; on missing Segoe UI, the next readable TrueType face is used without changing gameplay/single-image VR semantics.
First-run/regular font edits commit only after drag/key/pad deactivation or dismissal, retry failed INI writes, and avoid null-buffer font copies; desktop UI and non-F11 draw stay unchanged.
Exact source commit passes DX9Ex Active policy/game/host/full-chain/package and Domain Isolation, while Quest3/VDXR visual acceptance remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original first-run F11 font slider performed a synchronous settings_write and discarded its false return; the regular F11 frame-finaliser already retained dirty state across failed writes. Font loading tried only segoeui.ttf, then a 13px stretched bitmap face.
diagnosis.root_cause: First-run font edit and font-source fallback bypassed two established F11 capabilities: retriable frame-owned settings commits and scalable native-eye atlas reconstruction when the primary Windows face is absent.
source_trace: First-run modal Slate/ImGui slider writes GlobalFontScale and can defer via FontScalePending and FontScaleCommitRequested.
Frame finaliser validates scale, dirties the cached raster atlas and keeps SettingsDirtyPending until settings_write succeeds.
ImGui DX9 renders the external ScreenOverlay2D owner with the existing per-eye projection and protected desktop-only fallback.
alternatives_rejected: Avoid promoting all game HUD nodes to ScreenOverlay2D or altering R30/HMD stereo projection to fix a typeface issue.
Avoid per-frame disk lookups or repainting the font cache for each XR reset, since existing static font data already avoids stalls.
Avoid writing settings synchronously from the modal where a failed locked-file write loses the edit.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: F11 font and shell belong to ImGui's external D3D9 EndScene path, and R30 ScopedExternalOverlaySemantic maps a single logical F11 window into both XR eyes; game HUD producer tags are separate.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material C++ builds fallback TrueType candidates once and flushes first-run edits through the retriable shared frame-finaliser.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: verify_vr_f11_font_density.py pins alternate candidate ordering, per-file recoverable read failures, pending-write ownership and eight first-run destructive controls.
